import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("INVOICE_DB", "invoices.db")

SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS clients (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT,
    company TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS invoices (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    number TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    client_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES clients(id),
    issued TEXT NOT NULL,
    due TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'sent',
    tax_rate REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    invoice_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES invoices(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    qty REAL NOT NULL,
    unit_price REAL NOT NULL
);
"""


@contextmanager
def session():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
    try:
        yield conn
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def init_db():
    with session() as conn:
        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)

import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from datetime import date, timedelta

import db
import services


class ServiceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        db.DB_PATH = self.path
        db.init_db()
        self.client_id = services.add_client("Acme Ltd", "billing@acme.test", "Acme")

    def tearDown(self):
        os.remove(self.path)

    def make_invoice(self, due_days=14, status="sent", tax=0.0):
        today = date.today()
        return services.create_invoice(
            self.client_id,
            today.isoformat(),
            (today + timedelta(days=due_days)).isoformat(),
            [
                {"description": "Design work", "qty": 10, "unit_price": 50},
                {"description": "Hosting", "qty": 1, "unit_price": 25},
            ],
            tax_rate=tax,
            status=status,
        )

    def test_totals_use_quantity(self):
        inv = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice())
        self.assertEqual(inv["subtotal"], 525)
        self.assertEqual(inv["total"], 525)

    def test_tax_is_added(self):
        inv = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice(tax=16))
        self.assertEqual(inv["tax"], 84)
        self.assertEqual(inv["total"], 609)

    def test_invoice_numbers_increase(self):
        a = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice())
        b = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice())
        self.assertEqual((a["number"], b["number"]), ("INV-0001", "INV-0002"))

    def test_overdue_only_when_sent_and_past_due(self):
        late = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice(due_days=-3))
        paid_late = services.get_invoice(self.make_invoice(due_days=-3, status="paid"))
        self.assertTrue(late["overdue"])
        self.assertFalse(paid_late["overdue"])

    def test_dashboard_totals(self):
        self.make_invoice()
        self.make_invoice(status="paid")
        stats = services.dashboard()
        self.assertEqual(stats["outstanding"], 525)
        self.assertEqual(stats["paid"], 525)

    def test_cannot_delete_client_with_invoices(self):
        self.make_invoice()
        self.assertFalse(services.delete_client(self.client_id))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import tempfile
import unittest

import db
import services
from app import app


class RouteTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        fd, self.path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".db")
        os.close(fd)
        db.DB_PATH = self.path
        db.init_db()
        app.config["TESTING"] = True
        self.http = app.test_client()

    def tearDown(self):
        os.remove(self.path)

    def test_pages_load_when_empty(self):
        for url in ("/", "/clients", "/invoices", "/invoices/new", "/clients/new"):
            self.assertEqual(self.http.get(url).status_code, 200, url)

    def test_create_client_and_invoice_flow(self):
        self.http.post("/clients/new", data={"name": "Zuri", "email": "z@x.test"})
        self.assertEqual(len(services.list_clients()), 1)
        resp = self.http.post(
            "/invoices/new",
            data={
                "client_id": "1",
                "tax_rate": "10",
                "description": ["Logo", "Banner"],
                "qty": ["2", "1"],
                "unit_price": ["100", "50"],
            },
            follow_redirects=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200)
        self.assertIn(b"INV-0001", resp.data)
        self.assertIn(b"275.00", resp.data)

    def test_mark_paid(self):
        cid = services.add_client("Zuri")
        items = [{"description": "x", "qty": 1, "unit_price": 10}]
        iid = services.create_invoice(cid, "2026-01-01", "2026-01-15", items)
        self.http.post(f"/invoices/{iid}/status", data={"status": "paid"})
        self.assertEqual(services.get_invoice(iid)["status"], "paid")

    def test_missing_invoice_404(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.http.get("/invoices/99").status_code, 404)

    def test_summary_api(self):
        data = self.http.get("/api/summary").get_json()
        self.assertEqual(data["outstanding"], 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
